newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: C-C Amatil shrs soar on San Miguel tie-up.
newsitem.headline: C-C Amatil shrs soar on San Miguel tie-up.

text.p: Shares in beverage group Coca Cola Amatil Ltd jumped over two percent on Thursday on news that it was to issue A$3.4 billion worth of shares to San Miguel Corp of the Philippines.
At 10.35 a.m. (0035 GMT), Coca-Cola Amatil shares were 33 cents or 2.76 percent up at A$12.28 on a turnover of 375,792 shares.

C-C Amatil said San Miguel would hold 25 percent of the Australian-based soft drinks group and become its second largest shareholder after The Coca-Cola Co which will hold 33 percent of the expanded issued capital.
Shares in the bottling group have fallen sharply from its record high of A$18.15 hit last October on investor concerns over the group's 1996 annual results.
The Sydney-based group late last year placed about 9.3 percent of its shares with Robert Kuok's Hong Kong-based Kerry Group.
